_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at capture scale 2.2417 (881x1910 for 393x852); run with --pt 2.2417. --against wants a directory of renders resized to 881x1910 with the masked corners composited onto the capture, which is what scratch/run.sh writes to scratch/cap/; every probe names its own file there. 'bright' on a sample means the ink is lighter than its ground; on a bbox it is the luminance above which a pixel is ink. 06, 07 and 13-15 are native captures at 3 px/pt (1206x2622 for 402x874); their probes carry "pt": 3, which overrides the command line, and scratch/run13.sh writes their composites to the same scratch/cap/. The status bar on those five is the template's, not the capture's, so no probe sits above y 59. 08-12 are 2.2417 again (881x1910 after the Mobbin footer is dropped); cp8, cp9 and cp12 are read after the per-channel cast correction the README describes, which is what assets/refs holds.
